title: Courtesy Waiver Coverage of Late Fee Lines
content:
Which late fee lines of an Apartment Home Lease period a courtesy waiver covers follows the late fees already waived on the lease, the sum of the courtesy waiver credits on record: more than $250.00 already waived covers the period's initial late fee line only; any smaller amount above zero covers the initial late fee line and the period's first 5 daily late fee lines, each at the average amount of the daily late fee lines posted for the period (all of them when fewer have posted); nothing waived before covers every late fee line of the period.

**Records read.** The courtesy waiver credits on the lease ledger, for every period and at any date, summed; and the period's initial and daily late fee lines as posted. The covered amount is rounded half up to the cent.

## Guidance table

| Courtesy waiver credits already on record (sum) | Late fee lines covered |
|---|---|
| more than $250.00 | the initial late fee line only |
| more than $0.00 and no more than $250.00 | the initial late fee line plus 5 daily lines at the average daily line amount (every daily line when fewer than 5 have posted) |
| $0.00 | every late fee line of the period |

**Boundary.** Exactly $250.00 already waived falls in the middle row; $250.01 falls in the top row.

## Worked cases (hypothetical period: initial line $95.00)

| Daily late fee lines posted | Already waived | Covered late fees |
|---|---|---|
| 7 lines of $12.00 | $0.00 | $95.00 plus $84.00: $179.00 |
| 7 lines of $12.00 | $120.00 | $95.00 plus 5 times the $12.00 average: $155.00 |
| 6 lines of $12.00 and 1 line of $5.00 | $120.00 | average $11.00; $95.00 plus 5 times $11.00: $150.00 |
| 3 lines: $12.00, $12.00, $8.00 | $120.00 | fewer than 5 posted, all 3 lines: $95.00 plus $32.00: $127.00 |
| 7 lines of $12.00 | $300.00 | the initial line only: $95.00 |
